verdict.rationale: YYLO is a coding-agent orchestrator, so a plan-review gate is a fair question, but the pack never documents a step where a developer reviews and approves an agent's implementation plan before code changes. The 'plan/apply flow' covers creating a new Simple checkout (workspace migration), not agent plans. Read-only preflight, benchmark experiment planning and a 'Do not edit files' prompt are adjacent features or user workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review and approve an agent's implementation plan before any code changes are made
